units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 12:19">Targ. Prov. XII, 19</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Shabbat 65b:3">Sabb. 65ᵇ</cite> <he>מטרא … ס׳ רבה פרת</he> (the rise of) the Euphrates is a weighty witness (indication) that it rained in Palestine; a. fr.—Pl. <he>סַהֲדִין</he>, <he>סַהֲדַיָּא</he>, <he>סַהֲדֵי</he>, <cite ref="O00497"><he>שַׂ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 22:2">Targ. O. ib. 2</cite>; a. fr.—B. Bath. l. c.

<cite ref="Kiddushin 65b:10">Kidd. 65ᵇ</cite> <he>לא איברו ס׳ אלא לשקרי</he> witnesses are created only for liars, i.e. the institution of witnesses is not intended to legalise an act, but only as a guard against faithless persons who might deny the transaction.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shevuot 6:6:4">Y. Shebu. VI, end, 37ᵇ</cite> <he>פומהון דש׳</he>, v. <cite ref="O00212">preced. art.</cite>

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shevuot 6:6:4">Ib.</cite> <he>ייתי עלוי ש׳</he> let him produce witnesses to confirm it. Y. Snh. III, end, 21ᵈ <he>וקבלון לש׳ וכ׳</he> and they received (heard) the witnesses in the absence of &c.; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 17b:10">Ber. 17ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>אנן ס׳</he> we know certainly.—Fem. <cite ref="O00213"><he>סַהֲדָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 31:52">Targ. O. Gen. XXXI, 52</cite>.—V. <cite ref="O00216"><he>סָהִיד</he></cite>.
